📖 Game script

With Jaxson Dart on IR, Jameis Winston (211+ passing) starts for the Giants, who score 15.3 points a game and are also missing pass rusher Brian Burns. Arizona has a HIGH secondary grade here (severity 7.32): Jacoby Brissett (231+; 38 of 52 for 280 last week) throws to Trey McBride (64+, +151 to score) and Marvin Harrison Jr., and Jeremiyah Love (67+ rushing, −136 to score) takes the work with James Conner out. New York's path is Malik Nabers (57+) on a MEDIUM grade and Najee Harris near the goal line (Sean Koerner, +330). Arizona by four, covering −2.5; 44 total.

🧠 Why the card leans this way

The line flipped five points, from the Action Network open of NYG −2.5 to ARI −2.5, on the Dart news. ARI: Chad Millman (on Arizona early), Sharp or Square (+1.5 before the flip) and BettingPros on the moneyline ("Winston is unreliable as a market favorite"). NYG: Brandon Anderson (+2.5, "the line shouldn't have flipped this much"), Steve Makinen of VSiN (+2.5, "not sure the right team is favored here"), Matt Moore (+1.5 contest pick), Steve Fezzik and Ross Tucker teasing NYG to +7.5, and Mike Florio (Giants 23–17). The two contest picks are at the contest's +1.5. Andrew Erickson ("stay away") and Dave Tuley both pass. Money agrees with the move: ARI has 62% of spread tickets and 69% of the money, and the ARI moneyline is a big-money flag (62% of tickets, 78% of money). The lean is ARI −2.5 or the −143 moneyline. On the total, Action Network has over 44.5 and Zachary Cohen of VSiN has Jameis Winston's passing overs; Evan Abrams' primer notes Winston is 17–6 to the over in October in his career, while a wind-under system points the other way. The projection is half a point under, so pass the total; Winston's passing yards are the better angle. Card: the ARI moneyline anchors the Slot 3 Morning parlay, the Slot 5 Hybrid and the 2-leg ARI ML + JAX ML ticket; ARI −1.5 is a proposed SuperContest pick (both SuperContest tickets). The 7a Morning prop stack carries Jacoby Brissett 2+ passing TDs and a Jameis Winston interception.

⚠️ What breaks it

Winston's volatility cuts both ways: two long Nabers plays put the Giants ahead. Brissett has thrown 52 times in a game, and turnovers on that volume would hand New York the short field. There's a 53% chance of second-half showers (NWS), which would slow both passing games.
